introduction.text: The Twin Jet is a bipolar nebula with two opposing lobes. Published distance estimates range from 650 to about 1,300 parsecs.

distance.method: Adopted model distance, not a parallax. Published expansion alternative:1300±200pc.

classification.name: Bipolar nebula
classification.basis: Axially symmetric, image-conditioned Hubble emission model; single-image depth and inclination remain unmeasured. Adopted650pc model distance is uncertain; published expansion distance1300±200pc would double this physical size. The accepted baseline contains no stellar catalogue.
